title: A hypothetical worker throughput envelope
method: Assume each job uses 25 ms CPU + 75 ms non-overlapping wait. Serial ceiling = 1,000/100 = 10 jobs/s; CPU ceiling = 1,000/25 = 40 jobs/s. Parallel overhead, contention and dependency limits are excluded.
alt: A hypothetical worker throughput envelope. Serial ceiling: 10 jobs per second; One-CPU ceiling: 40 jobs per second. Illustrative inputs.
